100:10.text: And that which is in the breasts

100:11.text: their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them
(as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds)

101:1.text: (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection)

101:3.text: And what will make you know what the striking

101:4.text: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.

101:5.text: And the mountains will be like carded wool.

101:6.text: Then as for him whose balance

101:7.text: He will live a pleasant life

101:8.text: But as for him whose balance

101:9.text: He will have his home in Hâwiyah

101:10.text: And what will make you know what it is?

102:3.text: Nay! You shall come to know!

102:4.text: Again nay! You shall come to know!

102:5.text: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge
(the end result of piling up, you would not have been occupied yourselves in worldly things)

102:6.text: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire

102:7.text: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!

102:8.text: Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights
